name: signature-upsell
description: Builds both Signature upsell page instances of a Signature Launch: Upsell 1 (offered after a verified original purchase) and Upsell 2 (one canonical page, offered after a verified accepted Upsell 1 or Downsell 1 purchase). Uses the derived eight-section copy profile with a CTA in every section, exact amount and terms disclosure beside the guarded native one-click action, and deterministic copy validation. Eligibility is proven purchase only: a bump alone never qualifies and a client-side claim is never purchase proof.
intent_triggers: add an upsell to my launch
build the upsell flow for my launch
